purpose: Representative regression cases for surgical prompt migration and adaptive reasoning routing. These are specifications, not benchmark claims.

cases.request: Review the implementation and report findings.
Fix the scoped bug and run relevant tests.
assertions: make in-scope local changes without asking again

cases.request: Publish the validated branch to the named repository.
assertions: treat the named publish as authorized

cases.request: Prepare a publication plan.
Inspect and update a GitHub repository.
assertions: use connector for every remote GitHub operation
block if connector capability is unavailable

cases.request: Compare three independent configuration files.
Resolve a ref, inspect its commit, then decide whether to update it.
assertions: do not act on an assumed SHA

cases.request: Find the required artifact.
assertions: do not equate empty result with nonexistence
try at most two meaningful fallbacks

cases.request: Answer with source-backed claims.
Deduplicate and rank a large record set.
assertions: use PTC only for bounded read-only reduction when available
define compact schema and retry limit
return to direct judgment for final answer

cases.request: Perform a multi-step repository audit.
assertions: update at major phase changes only

cases.request: Make the requested incremental frontend change.
assertions: preserve design system and responsive states

cases.request: Rewrite the supplied artifact for clarity.
assertions: preserve structure genre length and claims

cases.request: Migrate a working GPT-5.5 prompt to GPT-5.6.
assertions: test same and one lower level
change one prompt group at a time

cases.request: Resolve the task with the available evidence.
assertions: stop when success criteria are met
do not search for phrasing only

cases.request: Generate a prompt to change exactly ‘colour’ to ‘color’ in a known file and verify no occurrences remain.
assertions: telos is closed and execution is mechanical

cases.request: Generate a prompt to inspect one known file and return the exact declared schemaVersion without mutation.
assertions: state is known and validation is exact
no mutation risk raises the floor

cases.request: Generate a prompt to modify a known component, update its tests, and run the affected build.
Generate a prompt to fix a reproduced bug in an existing module and add regression tests.
assertions: debugging is bounded by a known reproduction

cases.request: Generate a prompt to publish one verified commit to an existing non-default branch through the connector.
assertions: publication is precise reversible and bounded
base and branch prerequisites are explicit

cases.request: Generate a prompt to redesign a capability across several subsystems while preserving compatibility.
assertions: architecture and compatibility are hard triggers
prompt length does not lower the risk floor

cases.request: Generate a continuation to recover an uncertain workspace after a delegated chat was interrupted.
assertions: unknown interrupted state is a hard trigger

cases.request: Generate a prompt to permanently delete unmerged branches and unrecoverable artifacts.
assertions: destructive irreversible action is a hard trigger

cases.request: Generate a prompt to modify the global orchestrator and classify reasoning for other agents.
assertions: global policy and agent classification are hard triggers
orchestrator work is not treated as ordinary code

cases.request: Generate a fully closed prompt for an initially complex change with exact files, edits, order, fallbacks, validation, and stop rules, with no remaining hard trigger.
assertions: prompt closure reduces by exactly one level

cases.request: Generate a completely specified linear prompt for a bounded task after all local choices and validation steps have been fixed.
assertions: prompt closure reduces by exactly one level

cases.request: Generate an extremely detailed prompt for work initially classified High.
assertions: High cannot reduce directly to Instant
maximum prompt closure discount is one level
detail alone does not prove closure

cases.request: Generate a granular prompt for a destructive recovery involving unknown state and authentication.
assertions: hard triggers prevent prompt closure downgrade
unknown state and authentication preserve the floor

cases.request: A delegated result returned; generate the next continuation prompt.
assertions: recover original telos and classify remaining work from zero
do not inherit the previous level
emit a newly selected allowed level

cases.request: The initial architecture is now verified and only a bounded implementation remains.
assertions: recompute from the reduced remaining scope
level may decrease from High to Medium
repeat the trailing directive even if unchanged from another iteration

cases.request: A Medium continuation revealed corruption, contradictory remote state, and lost files.
assertions: recovery and contradictory evidence escalate to High

cases.request: Generate one delegated prompt.
assertions: one prompt code block appears first
reasoning directive is outside the block
directive is not part of pasted prompt

cases.request: Generate one delegated prompt and reasoning recommendation.
assertions: directive appears immediately after the closing fence
no explanation appears between block and directive

cases.request: Generate one delegated prompt.
assertions: reasoning directive is the final response element
no text appears after the directive

cases.request: Generate exactly one prompt for another chat.
assertions: zero other text outside the block

cases.request: Generate separate prompts for two independent delegated workstreams.
assertions: each prompt has its own immediate directive
no global reasoning recommendation is shared
final element is the second prompt directive

cases.request: Generate a delegated prompt.
assertions: directive value is one of Instant Medium High

cases.request: Generate a delegated prompt for the latest available model.
assertions: internal target model is latest available
visible directive does not contain Modelo
visible directive does not contain último disponible

cases.request: Generate a Medium delegated prompt.
assertions: line contains no explanation or justification

cases.request: Describe the required runtime configuration for the orchestrator.
assertions: configuration is user-set in ChatGPT Web

cases.request: Generate a prompt for another ChatGPT Web chat.
assertions: target model policy remains latest available

cases.request: Answer a factual question directly without generating a prompt.
assertions: do not append routing metadata unnecessarily

cases.request: Generate a delegated technical implementation prompt.
assertions: active minds list includes Eudaimonia Telos Ergon Grug Phronesis and Arete together
compact Grug contract is inside the prompt block
Synthesis does not appear as a seventh mind

cases.request: Delegate a technical task with two valid approaches of different complexity.
assertions: challenge accidental complexity premature abstractions unjustified dependencies and speculative scope
choose the simplest maintainable complete solution
do not confuse simplicity with underengineering

cases.request: Show the internal debate among the active minds.
assertions: return decision evidence and material tradeoffs only

cases.request: Explain Grug guidance for an implementation.
Delegate one exact reversible mechanical text replacement.
